earnings.title: Trane Technologies Reports Strong Third-Quarter Results;
highlights: SWORDS, Ireland, October 29, 2026 - Trane Tech nologies plc (NYSE:TT), a global climate innovator, today reported diluted earnings per share (EPS) from continuing operations of $4.79 for the third quarter of 2026.
Adjusted continuing EPS was $4.86, up 25 percent.

quotes.text: We delivered strong performance in the third quarter, including organic revenue growth of 16 percent, record operating income and earnings-per-share growth of 25 percent.
quotes.by: Dave Regnery, chair and CEO of Trane Technologies

items.heading: Our global operations subject us to economic risks.
Commodity and raw material shortages, supply chain risks and price increases could adversely affect our financial results.
Our growth is dependent, in part, on the timely development, commercialization and acceptance of new and enhanced products and services.
Capital and credit market conditions could adversely affect our business operations, investments, and financial performance.
Currency exchange rate fluctuations and other related risks may adversely affect our results.
Changes in U.S. or foreign trade policies and other factors beyond our control may adversely impact our business and operating results.
